integrity: The distributional limit and Wasserstein bound follow analytically from a common-coupling proof; finite verification is corroborative only. Earlier finite-rate moments and dynamics are credited; independent audit is absent.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive translational inertia, independent translational and angular Brownian noises, complete Poisson resetting of all state variables to zero position/velocity and fixed orientation; stationary one-time planar position, with joint strong-activity/high-reset limit. No claims for partial resetting, random reset angles, finite-data inference or rotational inertia.
title: A quantitative activity–reset crossover law for planar inertial active Brownian motion
